about: What each set really moves, for src/dev/moves_probe.gd, in Playable's words: moves are the words true of it, sure those it plainly has that a card must say. Judged from its renders and its own steps before the rule was changed (moves268, 2026-10-25); the held out sets were chosen and judged then too, and opened only after; held_out_2 was chosen and judged before the rule's second change (a crane's arm with no hook by name, motions_probe's 4096-1) and opened only after it.

6080-1.mpd.name: King's Castle
6080-1.mpd.why: The drawbridge (a 6 x 10 plate on a Technic pin) lowers on its chains and a wing of the castle swings open on hinge bricks. A drawbridge is a gate; nothing is a boom.

10183-1.mpd.name: Hobby Train
10183-1.mpd.why: The locomotives' halves turn on their bogies; the cab's door is part of a half, and does not open.

5891-1.mpd.name: Apple Tree House
5891-1.mpd.why: The garage door, plates and panels with a handle, tips up on its hinge. Not a boom.

8862-1.mpd.name: Backhoe Grader
8862-1.mpd.why: A backhoe on a turntable with its bucket, a front bucket, pneumatic cylinders, steering arms and gears.

6973-1.mpd.name: Deep Freeze Defender
6973-1.mpd.why: The roller doors open. The sections on pins are the ship's wings and cockpits: no boom.

6066-1.mpd.name: Camouflaged Outpost
6066-1.mpd.why: A section of the rock swings open on a pin, a hidden door. Not a boom.

10124-1.mpd.name: Wright Flyer
10124-1.mpd.why: The propellers turn by gears and a belt; the hinged plates are its surfaces, not a boom.

42022-1.mpd.name: Hot Rod
42022-1.mpd.why: The engine's pistons turn by gears from the axle and the front wheels steer. The beams on pins are its panels: no boom.

5521-1.mpd.name: Sea Jet
5521-1.mpd.why: Two toggle joints tilt; nothing lifts a load.

851-1.mpd.name: Tractor
851-1.mpd.why: The steering wheel drives a rack, the rear axle a differential. The hitch and the bodywork on axles are no boom.

6043-1.mpd.name: Dragon Defender
6043-1.mpd.why: A catapult, its arm throwing from a bucket, and a dragon's head on a pin. The catapult's arm may be called a boom; the head is not.

5984-1.mpd.name: Lunar Limo
5984-1.mpd.why: Its canopy and wings open on hinges; nothing lifts a load.

6361-1.mpd.name: Mobile Crane
6361-1.mpd.why: A crane's arm with its hook, and shutters.

5935-1.mpd.name: Island Hopper
5935-1.mpd.why: The wings fold on click hinges: no boom.

6073-1.mpd.name: Knight's Castle
6073-1.mpd.why: A castle: its drawbridge and doors.

6074-1.mpd.name: Black Falcon's Fortress
6074-1.mpd.why: A fortress that opens on hinges, and its gate.

6030-1.mpd.name: Catapult
6030-1.mpd.why: A catapult on wheels: its arm may be called a boom, as Dragon Defender's.

42004-1.mpd.name: Mini Backhoe Loader
42004-1.mpd.why: Its backhoe slews on a Technic turntable turned by a 20 tooth gear in its 28 teeth: gears, which the first judging missed and the held out run showed.

6062-1.mpd.name: Battering Ram
6062-1.mpd.why: The ram swings in its frame; it lifts nothing.

6658-1.mpd.name: Bulldozer
6658-1.mpd.why: Its blade lifts on its arms, which may be called a boom. It steers by bending on an articulated hinge plate, its wheels on either side: steering as the rule names it, which the judging before missed and the run showed.

6542-1.mpd.name: Launch & Load Seaport
6542-1.mpd.why: Its vehicles' front axles turn on tiles with pins under them, a toy's steering as the rule names it, which the judging before missed and the run showed.
